request.text: 欢迎使用云笺，{name}！开启离线模式后，你仍可编辑笔记；重新联网时，修改会自动同步到工作区。
request.style: 简洁、友好的产品文案；保留占位符

model: 手工编写的流程示例（非模型实测）
initial_translation: Welcome to CloudNote, {name}! Turn on offline mode and you can still edit notes. When you connect again, your changes will automatically sync to your work area.

style.explanation: 产品文案可采用更简洁自然的说法。
style.suggestion: 使用 When you're back online。

terminology.explanation: 未使用术语表规定的 workspace。
terminology.suggestion: 将 work area 改为 workspace。

revised_translation: Welcome to CloudNote, {name}! With offline mode on, you can still edit your notes. When you're back online, your changes will automatically sync to your workspace.
